paper_id: Cao et al. - 2012 - L(^mbox2) Lazy forwarding in low duty cycle wireless sensor networks
title: L^2: Lazy Forwarding in Low Duty Cycle Wireless Sensor Networks
motivation: X-MAC长前导(~264ms)过度耗能且低估链路质量; duty-cycle下链路突发丢失被忽视
problem_framing: 将数据转发设计解耦为媒体访问/链路估计/路由策略三个维度,并分析bursty loss对能耗的影响
key_insight: 链路突发性意味着短时间内多个传输相互关联;用多元伯努利模型精确刻画,在bursty loss时提前停止传输以节能
method_signature: 窗口传输+本地同步+多元伯努利链路模型+动态多前向者调度
evaluation_criteria: PDR(分组投递率)、Radio-on duty cycle(-radio开启占比)、前导长度、能量效率
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: 同步偏差可能导致丢包,确定性转发无法即时提供备份前向者;广播时macdsn计数不完美,P略高估实际概率
evidence_for_taste: the transmission is terminated...when bursty loss occurs
misled by such overestimates of link quality
the energy cost distribution on multiple forwarders is likely to be inefficient
if the link suffers heavy bursty loss, the transmission window should be kept small to avoid useless retransmissions
it can be proved that the above optimization problem is NP-hard
such approximation does not degrade the overall PDR
thinking_moves: 从GreenOrbs实际部署的工程异常反推X-MAC链路质量被高估
将一个communication问题(frame成perception问题):用链路突发性建模替代独立伯努利假设
先证原问题NP-hard,再提出贪心近似算法保证次优解
把长前导分解为多个短前导,通过同步协商实现lazy传输
